Name: Example — Push-In (Ease)
Description: A slow dolly-in on a still Mandelbulb. The camera holds a fixed elevation and barely turns, but pushes from distance 3.4 to 1.7 with Ease In-Out keys, so the move starts gently, accelerates, and settles to a stop. Demonstrates per-key easing plus a dolly (distance) move. Export it to add motion blur.
